children: RNS Number : 4040U  Everplay Group plc  11 September 2026
11 September 2026
everplay group plc
("everplay", the "Group" or the "Company")
Wardogs passes one million copies sold

everplay, a leading global independent ("indie") developer and publisher of premium video games, working simulation games and children's edutainment apps notes the announcement by Bulkhead and is pleased to announce an update on the performance of Wardogs, following its release on Thursday, 10 September 2026.

Wardogs, the 100-player tactical first-person shooter game, has exceeded one million copies sold in day one after launching into Steam Early Access, also reaching over 340,000 concurrent players on Steam.
Wardogs has been developed by Bulkhead, with which everplay has a strategic partnership via its stake in Super Media Group, and is published by Team17.
everplay will report its interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Tuesday, 15 September 2026.
Mikkel Weider, Group Chief Executive Officer of everplay, commented:

"Selling more than one million copies on day one is a truly fantastic achievement by Bulkhead and Team17. I would like to thank everyone for their tremendous work! I'm really excited about our partnership with Bulkhead and proud to be part of the Wardogs franchise."

About everplay group plc

everplay group plc (formerly Team17 Group plc) is an award-winning and leading global indie games label developer and publisher of premium video games and apps, comprising three distinct divisions: team17, astragon and StoryToys. team17 is a games developer, publisher and creative partner for indie developers around the world, known for iconic IP such as Hell Let Loose, Worms, Wardogs, Dredge and Overcooked!. astragon is a leading games publisher, developer and distributor of sophisticated working simulation games, including Construction Simulator and Police Simulator, targeting a broad audience from young enthusiasts to technical experts and casual gamers. StoryToys is a world-class developer and publisher of educational entertainment apps, bringing the world's most popular characters, worlds and stories to life for children under the age of eight, with apps including Disney Colouring World and LEGO® Bluey™.
